subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If the ratio of A:B is 3:4 and B:C is 8:9, what is the ratio of A:C?
solution: A/B = 3/4, B/C = 8/9. A/C = (A/B) * (B/C) = (3/4) * (8/9) = 24/36 = 2/3. Topic (Ratio and Proportion) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
